name: Colgate-Palmolive Company
summary: Colgate-Palmolive Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells consumer products in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments: Oral, Personal and Home Care; and Pet Nutrition. The Oral, Personal and Home Care segment offers toothpaste, toothbrushes, mouthwash, bar and liquid hand soaps, shower gels, shampoos, conditioners, deodorants and antiperspir
style_reason: weder klarer Wachstums- noch klarer Value-Wert
verdict: Einstufung: Standardwert (gemischt) – weder klarer Wachstums- noch klarer Value-Wert. Buffett-Score 59/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 32/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 63.38 USD (−36 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
